<!-- Source page: Networking working group -->

The router working group is various people who collaborate and share ideas in [\#networking:nixos.org](https://matrix.to/#/#networking:nixos.org) on Matrix.

## Example configurations

- disassembler's router config: <https://github.com/disassembler/network/blob/master/nixos/portal/configuration.nix>

## Work in Progress

A couple of projekts are in development for this topic:

- [liminix](https://gti.telent.net/dan/liminix) - A Nix-based system for configuring consumer wifi routers or IoT device devices, of the kind that OpenWrt or DD-WRT or Gargoyle or Tomato run on.
- [NixWRT](https://github.com/telent/nixwrt) - replacing OpenWRT with the nix toolchain.
  - This project has been archived
  - [NixWRT Project Update 2018-01-16](https://www.reddit.com/r/NixOS/comments/7qq14j/in_the_nix_of_time_nixwrt_project_update/)
  - [Musl support in nixpkgs](https://groups.google.com/forum/#!topic/nix-devel/zDQH7Ulotoc)
- [dewclaw](https://git.eno.space/dewclaw.git/tree/openwrt) - generate OpenWRT UCI config from Nix
- [Not-OS](https://github.com/cleverca22/not-os) - an operating system generator, based on NixOS, that, given a config, outputs a small (47 MB), read-only squashfs for a runit-based operating system
